name: CardiAMP-HF trial design
description: Peer-reviewed protocol describing randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled pivotal trial design.
citation: Raval AN et al. The CardiAMP Heart Failure trial: trial rationale and study design. Am Heart J. 2018;201:141-148. doi:10.1016/j.ahj.2018.03.016.
extracted_claim: The CardiAMP-HF pivotal study was designed as a randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled evaluation of autologous bone-marrow mononuclear cells; the primary endpoint was change in 6-minute walk distance adjusted for major adverse cardiovascular events at 12 months.

name: CardiAMP-HF reported primary outcome
description: Sponsor presentation reporting that the primary efficacy composite was not met.
citation: BioCardia. Corporate Presentation, August 2025, CardiAMP HF Trial Results slide.
extracted_claim: The sponsor presentation states that the primary efficacy 3-tier composite outcome was not met; it separately reports a favourable subgroup observation for baseline NT-proBNP >500 pg/mL.

context.subgroup_inference: do not treat as trial success; interaction and multiplicity details require source-level verification

endpoints.notes: Sponsor presentation states primary efficacy composite was not met; numerical estimate and denominator not populated in this curated snapshot.
Sponsor-reported favourable subgroup observation; no interaction or multiplicity evidence encoded here, so no effect-modification conclusion is drawn.

limitations: Outcome is sponsor-reported.
Subgroup observation is not evidence of overall trial success.
Interaction testing and multiplicity details not encoded in the source snapshot.

name: ProtheraCytes potency assay development
description: Peer-reviewed in-vitro characterization of clinical batches and VEGF-based potency assay.
citation: Aries A et al. Development of a potency assay for CD34+ cell-based therapy. Sci Rep. 2023;13:19665. doi:10.1038/s41598-023-47079-8.
assay: VEGF secretion and in-vitro angiogenic characterization
extracted_claim: The study characterized clinical batches and reported VEGF concentration as the most practical, reliable and consistent potency assay among the tested readouts.

context.evidence_scope: potency assay development; not proof of clinical efficacy

name: EXCELLENT trial design and manufacturing
description: Peer-reviewed EXCELLENT trial design paper describing autologous expanded CD34+ manufacturing and endpoint hierarchy.
citation: Transendocardial injection of expanded autologous CD34+ cells after myocardial infarction: Design of the EXCELLENT trial. ESC Heart Failure. doi:10.1002/ehf2.15124.
extracted_claim: The protocol describes expanded autologous CD34+ cells (ProtheraCytes), manufactured in licensed cell-therapy centres, with the primary objective of adjudicated major adverse cardiac events through six months and secondary efficacy objectives.

name: EXCELLENT trial health-related quality-of-life analysis
description: Peer-reviewed report of six-month HRQoL outcomes in a subset of EXCELLENT participants.
citation: Roncalli J et al. TransEndocardial Injection of Autologous Expanded CD34+ Stem Cells (ProtheraCytes) after myocardial infarction: Impact on Patients' Quality of Life. Stem Cell Rev Rep. 2026;22:1800-1810. doi:10.1007/s12015-026-11098-5.
extracted_claim: The report describes a randomized open-label controlled Phase I/IIb study with 77 enrolled participants; the per-protocol population was 49 and complete SF-36 data were available for 31 treated and 12 control participants. It reports within-group improvements in several HRQoL domains at six months.

limitations: small analyzable subset
open-label study
HRQoL analysis does not by itself establish the primary MACE endpoint
author affiliations include product developer; interpret with standard conflict-of-interest appraisal

endpoints.endpoint_name: Adjudicated major adverse cardiac events through six months
endpoints.notes: The HRQoL publication is not treated as a report of the primary MACE endpoint.
Complete SF-36 data were available for 31 treated and 12 control participants; within-group domain improvements do not establish a comparative treatment effect.

limitations: Open-label Phase I/IIb study.
Complete SF-36 data were available for a subset only (31 treated, 12 control).
HRQoL results do not establish the primary MACE endpoint.

name: ARTEMIS SGT-501 clinical trial registry
description: Clinical trial registry record for the Phase 1b SGT-501 study in CPVT.
citation: ClinicalTrials.gov. NCT07148089: A Study of SGT-501 Gene Therapy in Catecholaminergic Polymorphic Ventricular Tachycardia.
extracted_claim: The registry describes a Phase 1b, multicentre, open-label, dose-finding study of a single intravenous dose of SGT-501 in CPVT; registry status and participant dosing must be checked separately.

endpoints.notes: Registry describes the safety/tolerability objective; this record does not claim participant dosing or outcome data.

limitations: No human efficacy result is encoded.
Registry status and sponsor-anticipated first dosing are distinct.
First dosing was not confirmed by the cited registry snapshot.

name: Solid Biosciences SGT-501 development status
description: Sponsor SEC filing describing SGT-501 development milestones and anticipated first dosing.
citation: Solid Biosciences Inc. Form 10-Q for quarter ended September 30, 2026.
extracted_claim: The sponsor filing states that the ARTEMIS study is a Phase 1b open-label multicentre trial designed to evaluate safety and tolerability, with first participant dosing anticipated by the end of 2026 and initial safety data anticipated in the first half of 2027.
